046        public static boolean isSwarmPhaseMode(ShipAPI ship) {
047                RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(ship);
048                if (swarm instanceof DwellerShroud) swarm = null;
049                return swarm != null && swarm.params.tags.contains(SWARM_TAG_PHASE_MODE);
050        }

074        @Override
075        public void advance(float amount, CombatEngineAPI engine, WeaponAPI weapon) {
076                ShipAPI ship = weapon.getShip();
077                if (ship == null) return;
078                RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(ship);
079                if (swarm instanceof DwellerShroud) swarm = null;
080                int active = swarm == null ? 0 : swarm.getNumActiveMembers();
081                int required = getNumFragmentsToFire();
082                boolean disable = active < required;
083                weapon.setForceDisabled(disable);
084                
085                showNoFragmentSwarmWarning(weapon, ship);
086        }
087        
088        @Override
089        public int getNumFragmentsToFire() {
090                return FRAGMENTS_TO_FIRE;
091        }
092        
093        public void onFire(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
094                //ARC = 30f;
095                float emp = projectile.getEmpAmount();
096                float dam = projectile.getDamageAmount();
097                
098                RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(projectile.getSource());
099                if (swarm instanceof DwellerShroud) swarm = null;
100                if (swarm == null || swarm.getAttachedTo() == null) return;
101                
102                CombatEntityAPI target = findTarget(projectile, weapon, engine);
103                
104                Vector2f noTargetDest = null;
105                if (target == null) noTargetDest = pickNoTargetDest(projectile, weapon, engine);
106                
107                Vector2f towards = noTargetDest;
108                if (target != null) towards = target.getLocation();
109                
110                SwarmMember pick = pickFragmentTowardsPointWithinRange(swarm, towards, 150f);
111                if (pick == null) return;
112                
113                pick.setRecentlyPicked(1f);
114                
115                float thickness = 30f;
116                //Color color = weapon.getSpec().getGlowColor();
117                //Color color = new Color(255,0,0,255);
118                Color color = EMP_FRINGE_COLOR;
119                Color coreColor = Color.white;
120                
121                boolean phaseMode = isSwarmPhaseMode(projectile.getSource());
122                if (phaseMode) {
123                        color = PHASE_FRINGE_COLOR;
124                        if (target instanceof ShipAPI && ((ShipAPI)target).isPhased()) {
125                                coreColor = PHASE_CORE_COLOR;
126                        }
127                }
128                
129                float coreWidthMult = 0.75f;
130                
131                EmpArcParams params = new EmpArcParams();
132                params.segmentLengthMult = 8f;
133                //params.zigZagReductionFactor = 0.25f;
134                params.zigZagReductionFactor = 0.5f;
135                //params.maxZigZagMult = 0f;
136                //params.flickerRateMult = 0.75f;
137                params.flickerRateMult = 1f;
138                params.fadeOutDist = 1000f;
139                params.minFadeOutMult = 1f;
140//              params.fadeOutDist = 200f;
141//              params.minFadeOutMult = 2f;
142                params.glowSizeMult = 0.5f;
143                params.glowAlphaMult = 0.75f;
144                
145                // actually, probably fine given how long it takes to chew through the missile health with low damage per hit
146                //params.flamesOutMissiles = false; // a bit much given the RoF and general prevalence
147                
148                pick.flash();
149                pick.flash.forceIn();
150                pick.flash.setDurationOut(0.25f);
151                
152                //weapon.setAmmo(20);
153                
154                if (target != null) {
155                        EmpArcEntityAPI arc = engine.spawnEmpArc(projectile.getSource(), pick.loc, weapon.getShip(),
156                                           target,
157                                           DamageType.ENERGY, 
158                                           dam,
159                                           emp, // emp 
160                                           100000f, // max range 
161                                           "voltaic_discharge_emp_impact",
162                                           thickness, // thickness
163                                           color,
164                                           coreColor,
165                                           params
166                                           );
167                        arc.setCoreWidthOverride(thickness * coreWidthMult);
168                        arc.setSingleFlickerMode();
169                        arc.setUpdateFromOffsetEveryFrame(true);
170                        arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
171                        arc.setFadedOutAtStart(true);
172                } else {
173                        params.flickerRateMult = 1f;
174                        
175                        Vector2f to = noTargetDest;
176                        //Vector2f to = targetLoc;
177                        EmpArcEntityAPI arc = engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(pick.loc, weapon.getShip(), to, weapon.getShip(), thickness, color, coreColor, params);
178                        arc.setCoreWidthOverride(thickness * coreWidthMult);
179                        arc.setSingleFlickerMode();
180                        arc.setUpdateFromOffsetEveryFrame(true);
181                        arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
182                        arc.setFadedOutAtStart(true);
183                        //Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("shock_repeater_emp_impact", 1f, 1f, to, new Vector2f());
184                }
185        }
186        
187        public Vector2f pickNoTargetDest(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
188                float spread = 50f;
189                float range = Math.min(weapon.getRange() - spread, 150f);
190                Vector2f from = projectile.getLocation();
191                Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(weapon.getCurrAngle() + (EXTRA_ARC/2f - EXTRA_ARC * (float) Math.random()));
192                dir.scale(range);
193                Vector2f.add(from, dir, dir);
194                dir = Misc.getPointWithinRadius(dir, spread);
195                return dir;
196        }
197        
198        public CombatEntityAPI findTarget(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
199                float range = weapon.getRange() + 50f;
200                Vector2f from = projectile.getLocation();
201                
202                Iterator<Object> iter = Global.getCombatEngine().getAllObjectGrid().getCheckIterator(from,
203                                                                                                                                                        range * 2f, range * 2f);
204                int owner = weapon.getShip().getOwner();
205                CombatEntityAPI best = null;
206                float minScore = Float.MAX_VALUE;
207                
208                ShipAPI ship = weapon.getShip();
209                boolean ignoreFlares = ship != null && ship.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.PD_IGNORES_FLARES, 0) >= 1;
210                ignoreFlares |= weapon.hasAIHint(AIHints.IGNORES_FLARES);
211                
212                boolean phaseMode = isSwarmPhaseMode(ship);
213                
214                while (iter.hasNext()) {
215                        Object o = iter.next();
216                        if (!(o instanceof MissileAPI) &&
217                                        //!(o instanceof CombatAsteroidAPI) &&
218                                        !(o instanceof ShipAPI)) continue;
219                        CombatEntityAPI other = (CombatEntityAPI) o;
220                        if (other.getOwner() == owner) continue;
221                        
222                        boolean phaseHit = false;
223                        if (other instanceof ShipAPI) {
224                                ShipAPI otherShip = (ShipAPI) other;
225                                if (otherShip.isHulk()) continue;
226                                //if (!otherShip.isAlive()) continue;
227                                if (otherShip.isPhased()) {
228                                        if (phaseMode) {
229                                                phaseHit = true;
230                                        } else {
231                                                continue;
232                                        }
233                                }
234                                if (!otherShip.isTargetable()) continue;
235                        }
236                        
237                        if (!phaseHit && other.getCollisionClass() == CollisionClass.NONE) continue;
238                        
239                        if (ignoreFlares && other instanceof MissileAPI) {
240                                MissileAPI missile = (MissileAPI) other;
241                                if (missile.isFlare()) continue;
242                        }
243
244                        float radius = Misc.getTargetingRadius(from, other, false);
245                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(from, other.getLocation()) - radius;
246                        if (dist > range) continue;
247                        
248                        if (!Misc.isInArc(weapon.getCurrAngle(), EXTRA_ARC, from, other.getLocation())) continue;
249                        
250                        float score = dist;
251                        
252                        if (score < minScore) {
253                                minScore = score;
254                                best = other;
255                        }
256                }
257                return best;
258        }
259        
260        public static SwarmMember pickFragmentTowardsPointWithinRange(RoilingSwarmEffect swarm, Vector2f towards, float maxRange) {
261                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = swarm.getPicker(true, true, towards);
262                while (!picker.isEmpty()) {
263                        SwarmMember p = picker.pickAndRemove();
264                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(p.loc, swarm.getAttachedTo().getLocation());
265                        if (dist > maxRange) continue;
266                        return p;
267                }
268                return null;
269        }
